ValidationRule.description: When the opp Stage is changed to Close Lost, the Close Date cannot be older than the date the stage is changed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name != 'Bank-PSP Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Strategic Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Agents', ISPICKVAL (StageName, "Closed Lost"), CloseDate < TODAY (), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date can't be set in the past. Please update the Close Date to the day the Opp is set as Close Lost.
